name: Ultimate Spider-Man — "He gains hexproof and becomes colorless until end of turn"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). The colour parser wanted its subject directly before "becomes", so the colour after "gains hexproof and" was dropped; and a legendary character's "He" after "Put a +1/+1 counter on this card." was not resolved to the source the way "It" is. Fired, Camouflage leaves Ultimate Spider-Man colorless with hexproof.
